identity.note: This is the provider side of accountkit's `bitbaum-signin` client. accountkit's createAuthRuntime is a product's account system (password, link, passkeys); this service keeps no accounts of that kind, so it runs better-auth with @better-auth/oauth-provider and reuses accountkit's identity rule (placeholderEmail), its limits, and — in the tests — its real client runtime.

shell.exception: One screen with no navigation: a sitekit masthead and footer would be chrome around a list of provider buttons, and a footer link is a way out of a sign-in a person is in the middle of.

publishing.exception: Infrastructure, not a product: there is no public roadmap, changelog or blog page here to render with bip-kit.

chat.exception: The service has no chat surface of any kind; it renders a sign-in chooser and two notice pages.
